queries.scope: Identify current first-party local registry/cadastre and safe public parcel geometry.
queries.result: The official Ministry of Land Affairs lists Kikwit I and Kikwit II as land/cadastral jurisdictions in Kwilu. No public map or anonymous feature endpoint was found.
